basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old graphic designer based in Los Angeles, PrintsAndPixels is passionate about screen printing and digital art. When not working on creative projects, they enjoy unwinding with gaming sessions in Stardew Valley. They are a big fan of LAFC, attending games whenever possible. Though not very active on social media, they frequent Reddit during the evenings and weekends. Currently single, they appreciate the freedom to dive deep into hobbies and explore new interests like customizing their home media setup with libreELEC.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: PrintsAndPixels has a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and has honed their craft through both formal education and self-teaching. Their expertise lies in screen printing techniques, digital illustration, and increasingly, in home media solutions. They often share insights and tips gained from years of practical experience.
